title: console: English report and dashboard panel rows still show the spec's describe wording
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #36373 (PR #36420, the report and dashboard panels speak business wording). The dev and both reviewers found it out of scope with no carrier. Filed by the seat. Parent: #36373.

## What happens

In English, the report and dashboard panels' form rows still show the spec's own describe wording, for example "Dataset binding". #36420 rewords the zh-CN rows through the console's form overlay, but the English rows read the schema text directly. That wording is not a machine name, so the card's English acceptance line holds, but it reads as developer language next to the reworded Chinese rows.

## To do

1. List the English rows the report panel and the dashboard widget panel draw from spec describe text.
2. Give each a business label through the same overlay #36420 uses for zh-CN, matching the zh-CN wording's meaning.

## Acceptance

- In English, the report panel and the widget panel read in the same business terms as zh-CN, with no row that only makes sense to a schema author.

Blocked-by: #36420

## Grade
p3 · area:ux · domain:ui. Wording, nothing broken.
